trust_decision.summary: Whether a request from a user without Overall/Administer may read the global Gitee connection registry and the system credential IDs behind it; decided in the Stapler descriptor methods of GiteeConnectionConfig, where the guard is hasPermission(Item.CONFIGURE) - a permission held by any user with global Job/Configure.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names credential-ID enumeration; doFillApiTokenIdItems is the only endpoint in the plugin that renders system credentials, and its guard at line 155 is Item.CONFIGURE.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP descriptor method doCheckName on the global configuration descriptor (connection-name existence oracle)
HTTP descriptor method doTestConnection (/lib/form validateButton method=testConnection): takes an apiTokenId plus an arbitrary url/clientBuilderId/timeouts
HTTP descriptor method doFillClientBuilderIdItems (endpoint removed by the fix; no callers left in the jelly)
HTTP descriptor method doFillGiteeConnectionItems on the job-property descriptor (f:select for field giteeConnection)
HTTP descriptor method doAddWebhook on the nested WebhookEntry descriptor, called from the trigger form; guarded only by a jakarta.ws.rs @POST annotation, not by Stapler's @RequirePOST

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A job property is a legitimate wrapper over the global connection registry: non-admin job configurers must see connection names to pick one, and it exposes only names, never credential IDs, so a solver can argue the credential-enumeration protection does not reach it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Users with global Job/Configure but not Overall/Administer must still be able to open a job's Gitee connection property and select a connection; a blanket 'require Jenkins.ADMINISTER on every doFill endpoint' fix leaves that form empty and breaks legitimate job configuration.

O6_input_shapes: credential ID selected through a fill endpoint with name and url query parameters
credential ID passed directly to a connection-test endpoint together with an attacker-chosen url, clientBuilderId, ignoreCertificateErrors and timeouts
connection name passed to a name-existence check (id and value pair)
existing connection name selected on a job property (no parameters)
HTTP GET versus POST to the same descriptor endpoints (CSRF shape)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another doFill*Items helper on the global config descriptor that returns connection or credential metadata
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix deletes exactly this kind of helper (doFillClientBuilderIdItems), so a maintainer adding a new picker for the connection form and forgetting the guard is natural; the surrounding methods already follow the same unguarded doCheck*/doFill* style.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a descriptor-level credential or connection list helper next to the repo-owner picker
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This descriptor already caches global plugin state (descriptorOptions) and mutates and saves it from user-callable methods, so extending it with another global lookup is in keeping with the existing code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a doFill*Items helper on the WebhookEntry descriptor that lists the job's or the global Gitee connections
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The webhook form already takes job-scoped parameters through @AncestorInPath and already calls Jenkins.ADMINISTER, so a second endpoint there would look protected at a glance while being easy to leave on Item.CONFIGURE.

O9_family: Missing authorization / incorrect permission check (CWE-862), with missing POST requirement for CSRF (CWE-352)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven with org.jenkins-ci.plugins:plugin parent 6.2189.v695a_c41f5249, jenkins.baseline 2.528 / jenkins.version 2.528.3, hpi packaging
O10_build.project_tests: src/test/java/com/gitee/jenkins/connection/GiteeConnectionConfigTest.java (calls descriptor.doTestConnection against an in-process MockServer, connection map, authentication-enabled webhook endpoint), GiteeConnectionTest, GiteeApiRepoTest, trigger WebHookEntryTest, GiteePushTriggerTest; JenkinsRule + JUnit 5 + MockServer, no external services.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change Item.CONFIGURE to Jenkins.ADMINISTER only in doFillApiTokenIdItems (or narrow GiteeCredentialMatcher to fewer credential kinds), leaving doTestConnection, doCheckName and the wrong jakarta.ws.rs @POST untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Not pursued, outside this advisory's protection: GiteeApiRepoProperty's @JavaScriptMethod mutators addRepoOwner/removeRepoOwner/removeAllRepoOwners (src/main/java/com/gitee/jenkins/connection/GiteeApiRepoProperty.java:165-185) mutate and save global descriptor state with no permission check.
unverified: The full advisory text was not available, only the provided summary, so the exact wording of how many endpoints the advisory scopes is unknown.
Exact repository and source size in MB could not be measured (no shell); tiny_repo is asserted from the 282 files under src (157 Java files), which are far below 5 MB.
Whether Stapler exposes the @JavaScriptMethod descriptor mutators to unauthenticated callers was not verified.
Whether the removed doFillClientBuilderIdItems endpoint was reachable from any shipped jelly before the fix was not verified.
